newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RESEARCH ALERT - Merchant Bankers downgrades CIADEA.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Merchant Bankers downgrades CIADEA.

text.p: -- Merchant Bankers Asociados, an affiliate of Salomon Brothers, said it downgraded Argentina's CIADEA, local maker of Renault cars, to hold from buy.
-- "We are downgrading CIADEA to 'hold' based on the following reasons:
a) We now expect the industry recovery to be slower than previously estimated; and
b) we are lowering 1996 and 1997 earnings estimates, and expect consensus to do the same during the next months," Merchant Bankers said.

It added it was lowering CIADEA's earnings estimates for 1996 to $21 million ($0.191 per share) from $39 million ($0.354 per share) and for 1997 to $45 million ($0.409 per share) from $64 million ($0.582 per share).
These new estimates are below consensus, which are $33.7 million ($0.307 per share) for 1996 and $61.2 million ($0.556 per share) for 1997, Merchant Bankers said.
